questions.question: How many elements are listed in the modern periodic table?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**118 elements**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **118 elements** are currently listed in the modern periodic table.
 
• The modern periodic table is organized based on the **atomic number** of elements, which is the number of protons in the nucleus of an atom.
 
• Elements are arranged in rows called **periods** and columns called **groups** or families, where elements in the same group have similar chemical properties.
 
• The periodic table helps in understanding the **properties, behaviors, and trends** of elements, such as electronegativity, ionization energy, and atomic radius.
 
• It was developed based on the work of several scientists, most notably **Dmitri Mendeleev**, who is credited with creating the first widely recognized periodic table.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **modern periodic table** is a tabular arrangement of chemical elements, ordered by their **atomic number, electron configuration, and recurring chemical properties**.
 
• The rows of the table are called **periods**, and the columns are called **groups**.
 
• Elements are presented in order of increasing atomic number, which is the number of protons in the nucleus of an atom.
 
• The periodic table is a fundamental tool in the field of **chemistry** and is used extensively by chemists to predict the properties of elements and their compounds.
 
• The table has been expanded and refined over time as new elements have been discovered and new theoretical insights have been developed.

questions.question: What is the chemical name of battery acid?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sulfuric acid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The chemical name of the acid used in a car battery is Sulfuric acid__.
 
• Battery acid is sulfuric acid that has been diluted with water to attain a 37% concentration level.
 
• Car or automotive battery acid is 30-50% sulfuric acid (H2SO4) in water.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• A lead-acid battery consists of two lead plates separated by a liquid or gel containing sulfuric acid in water.
 
• The working of the lead-acid battery involves the formation of lead sulphate by oxidation of lead at the anode and reduction of lead dioxide at the cathode.
 
• During battery charge, the lead sulphate is converted back to lead and lead dioxide, releasing sulphuric acid into the electrolyte.
 
• As sulphuric acid is consumed during the discharge process and released during the charging process. 
 
• The specific gravity of the electrolyte changes during battery use and charge.

questions.question: What is the chemical name for the compound responsible for the cooling sensation in mint leaves?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Menthol**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Menthol** is an organic compound that is responsible for the **cooling sensation** experienced when consuming mint or mint-based products.
 
• It is a naturally occurring compound derived from **mint plants**, such as peppermint and spearmint.
 
• Menthol interacts with the **TRPM8 receptor**, which is a cold-sensitive receptor in the skin and mucous membranes, creating a cooling effect.
 
• It is widely used in various **applications**, including food, cosmetics, oral care products, and medicinal items like cough drops and topical analgesics.
 
• Menthol is also known for its **analgesic and soothing properties**, making it a common ingredient in balms and ointments for pain relief.
 
• The chemical formula of menthol is **C₁₀H₂₀O**, and it exists as a crystalline substance at room temperature.
 
• Menthol is utilized not only for its cooling effect but also for its **aromatic and flavoring properties** in products such as chewing gum, candies, and beverages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ethanol**__

 __
 
• **Ethanol**, also known as alcohol, is a volatile, flammable, and colorless liquid widely used as a **solvent**, in alcoholic beverages, and as a **biofuel.**
 
• Its chemical formula is **C₂H₅OH**.
 
• Unlike menthol, ethanol does not produce a cooling sensation but may be used as a solvent in products containing menthol.
 
 
 
• **Caffeine**__
 __
 
• **Caffeine** is a natural stimulant found in coffee, tea, and chocolate.
 
• It works by stimulating the central nervous system and is known for its role in increasing **alertness** and reducing fatigue.
 
• Chemically, its formula is **C₈H₁₀N₄O₂**, and it has no connection to the cooling sensation of mint leaves.
 
 
 
• **Capsaicin**__
 
 
• **Capsaicin** is the active compound found in chili peppers that gives them their **spicy and hot flavor.**
 
• It interacts with the **TRPV1 receptors**, which are heat-sensitive, creating a sensation of heat or burning.
 
• Unlike menthol, capsaicin produces a warming effect instead of a cooling one.

questions.question: Which of the following is a property of silicon dioxide?

options.text: It is a good conductor of electricity.
It has a high melting point.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It has a high melting point.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] 

Important Points__**

 
• SiO2 is an oxide of silicon.
 
• The chemical name is Silicon Dioxide.
 
• It is also called **Silica, Silicic oxide or silicic acid.**
 
• **Properties of silicon dioxide:**
 
 
• It is not soluble in water.
 
• It is a bad conductor of electricity.
 
• It is hard in nature.
 
• It has a high melting point.
 
• The molecular weight of SiO2 is 60.08 g/mol.
 
• The density of Silicon Dioxide is 2.648 g/cm³.
 
• The melting point of Silicon Dioxide is 1,713 °C.
 
• The boiling point of Silicon Dioxide is 2,950 °C.
 
 
 
• **Hence option 4 is the correct answer. **

questions.question: Which chemical element does ‘Fe’ stand for in the science periodic table?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Iron**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iron:-**

 
 
• Iron is a chemical element with symbol Fe and atomic number 26.
 
• It is a metal that belongs to the first transition series and group 8 of the periodic table.
 
• It is by mass the most common element on Earth, right in front of oxygen, forming much of Earth's outer and inner core.
 
• Iron is a mineral that the body needs for growth and development.
 
• Your body uses iron to make haemoglobin, a protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen from the lungs to all parts of the body.
 
 
 
• **Periodic table:-**
 
 
• It is a tabular presentation of the chemical elements, organized on the basis of their properties.
 
• Mendeleev’s Periodic Table (1869):
 
 
• It is based upon Mendeleev’s periodic law, which states, “Properties of the elements are the periodic function of their atomic masses.”
 
• Mendeleev is known as the father of the periodic table.
 
 
 
• Modern Periodic Law
 
 
• The physical and chemical properties of the elements are the periodic function of their atomic numbers.
 
 
 
• Modern Periodic Table:
 
 
• It is a graphical representation of the Aufbau principle.
 
• It is based on the electronic configuration of elements and contains 118 elements.
 
• There are 7 periods and 18 groups.
 
• Modern periodic table is classified as:
 
 
• i. s-block;
 
• ii. p-block;
 
• iii. d-block;
 
• iv. f-block
 
 
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Fluorine:-**

 
 
• It is the most electronegative element and also the most reactive non-metal.
 
• Fluorine is the most electronegative element.
 
• Fluorine has an electronegativity of 3.98 on the Pauling Electronegativity Scale and a valence of 1.
 
• A fluorine atom needs one electron to fill its outer electron shell and achieve stability, which is why free fluorine exists as the F- ion. 
 
 
 
• Oxygen:-
 
 
• It is a chemical element with the symbol O and atomic number 8.
 
• It is a member of the chalcogen group in the periodic table, a highly reactive nonmetal, and an oxidizing agent that readily forms oxides with most elements as well as with other compounds. 
 
 
 
• Fermium:-
 
 
• Fermium is an actinide series radioactive metal with the atomic number 100.
 
• Fermium does not occur naturally and was discovered in the debris of the first hydrogen bomb explosion in 1953.

questions.question: The element with atomic number 59 lies in which block of the Periodic Table?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The f-block**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The element with atomic number 59 is **Praseodymium (Pr)**, which belongs to the Lanthanide series.
 
• Lanthanides are part of the **f-block** of the Periodic Table, as their electrons fill the 4f orbital.
 
• Praseodymium is the third element in the Lanthanide series, with the electron configuration **[Xe] 4f³ 6s².**
 
• The f-block elements are also known as **inner transition elements**, and they include both Lanthanides and Actinides.
 
• Praseodymium exhibits unique magnetic, optical, and electronic properties, making it essential in applications such as alloys and glass manufacturing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lanthanides:**

 
 
• Lanthanides consist of 15 elements from atomic number 57 (Lanthanum) to 71 (Lutetium).
 
• These elements are known for their high magnetic susceptibility and are often used in high-tech applications like lasers and superconductors.
 
 
 
• **f-block Elements:**
 
 
• f-block elements are characterized by the filling of f-orbitals, which can hold up to 14 electrons.
 
• They are divided into Lanthanides and Actinides, and their unique electronic configurations give rise to special properties.
 
 
 
• **Electronic Configuration:**
 
 
• The general electron configuration for Lanthanides is [Xe] 4f¹⁻¹⁴ 5d⁰⁻¹ 6s².
 
• Praseodymium, specifically, has the configuration [Xe] 4f³ 6s².
 
 
 
• **Applications of Praseodymium:**
 
 
• Praseodymium is used in the creation of strong alloys for aircraft engines.
 
• It is also utilized in manufacturing colored glass and ceramics, especially yellow-green glass.
 
• In addition, it plays a role in producing high-strength permanent magnets.

questions.question: Which of the following is used as a preservative?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium Chloride.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sodium chloride,** commonly known as **table salt,** is an **ionic compound** with the chemical formula **NaCl.**
 
• In its edible form of table salt, it is commonly used as a **condiment** and **food preservative.**
 
• Sodium Chloride has a **1:1 ratio of sodium and chloride ions.**
 
• With molar masses of 22.99 and 35.45 g/mol respectively, **100 g of NaCl contains 39.34 g Na and 60.66 g Cl.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sodium chloride is the salt most responsible for the** salinity of seawater** and of the extracellular fluid of many multicellular organisms.
 
• Large quantities of sodium chloride are **used in many industrial processes,** and it is a major source of sodium and chlorine compounds used as feedstocks for further chemical syntheses.
 
• A second major application of sodium chloride is **de-icing of roadways in sub-freezing weather.**

questions.question: Which among the following is a noble chemical element of science periodic table?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Helium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Helium**:-

 
 
• **It is a noble chemical element with the symbol He and atomic number 2. **
 
• It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless, non-toxic, inert, monatomic gas and the first in the noble gas group in the periodic table.
 
• Its boiling point is the lowest among all the elements, and it does not have a melting point at standard pressure. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cobalt:-**

 
 
• **It is a chemical element with the symbol Co and atomic number 27. **
 
• It is a hard, silvery-white metal that is ferromagnetic (meaning it is attracted to magnets).
 
• Cobalt is found naturally in the Earth's crust and is mined from cobalt ore.
 
 
 
• **Nitrogen:-**
 
 
• **It is a chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. **
 
• It is a nonmetal and the lightest member of group 15 of the periodic table, often called the pnictogens.
 
• It is a common element in the universe, estimated at seventh in total abundance in the Milky Way and the Solar System.
 
 
 
• **Scandium:-**
 
 
• **It is a chemical element with the symbol Sc and atomic number 21. **
 
• It is a silvery-white metal that is lightweight and strong.
 
• Scandium is rare in nature and is found in small amounts in over 800 minerals.
